technical.zh-CN: RSS 为新加坡非营利学术与产业组织，工作涉及会议、研究交流、人才与跨国协作；不作为整机厂商计数。
technical.en: RSS is a Singapore nonprofit academic/industrial organization for conferences, research exchange, talent and international cooperation. It is not counted as a robot manufacturer.
